## ExpiryDebugInfo.expiresOccurrences property

Every `Expires` attribute seen while parsing, in the order in which they appeared. The last parseable one is applied to the cookie.

**Signature:**

```typescript
expiresOccurrences: ExpiresDebugOccurrence[];
```
